title: 2024 Topps  Update Chrome X-Fractor Tommy Pham USC111
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2024 Topps Update Chrome X-Fractor card features Tommy Pham, a player for the St. Louis Cardinals in Major League Baseball. The card is a sports trading card with a foil design and a card number of USC111. It belongs to the Topps Update Chrome set and is a parallel variety X-Fractor card. The card is perfect for collectors and fans of Tommy Pham and the St. Louis Cardinals.
